roomPalette.tint: TINT multiply keyed by solar altitude: -18 #3a417c, -9 #474f8f, -4 #7468aa, -0.5 #cf9aae, 3 #ffdcb8, 9 #fff3e6, 15 #ffffff
roomPalette.artGrid: 112 art px tall; W art px wide (about 180-260); integer device px per art px chosen near W=220; nearest-neighbour blit; 4x4 Bayer dither for light and sky
roomPalette.sprite: public/photos/winnie-room-v3.png, 3x10 cells of 64 art px; packed by scripts/pack-poses.mjs
roomPalette.furniture: Warm cream wall and sofa, rust throw, sage pillow, light wood floor, yellow crate cover with cream lattice and pink rectangular bolster bed. The sofa and crate stay behind Winnie; the bed rim overlays him only while asleep in bed.
roomPalette.ribbon: Flat blue CGC ribbon, 9x20 art px, with gold marks; tapping names it without inferring a graduation date or creating a milestone.

harness.appearance: Cream chest piece, red/yellow straps and green hardware, replacing the bandanna.
harness.behavior: After a current pee/poop log while awake and home: harness on, walk toward door, happy pose and sparkles, walk back, sit, bandanna restored. Saving and offline queuing do not wait for animation. Interruptions and reduced motion clear the harness; active sleep/walk reactions remain unchanged. Missing harness artwork falls back to the normal sprite.
harness.privacy: Personal reference photograph is not bundled or published.

roomPalette.lighting: Real San Francisco sky and weather remain unchanged. Device-local Room lights warms the interior while retaining the real window sky; off restores natural lighting. Hidden tabs pause animation.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Log tile after a log: down 3px, up 3px at 1.03, settle.

motion.name: fresh
motion.purpose: New timeline row fades from Sun Yellow at 60%.

motion.name: room-tick
motion.purpose: Room logic tick; whole art-pixel moves; walk frame swap every 4 ticks; hop arc 0,3,5,6,5,3,0; fades quantised to quarters.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All CSS animation collapses; room settles to the final pose instantly; breathing and skyline walker off.

breakpoints.name: desktop-frame

narrative.overview:
The app opens onto a 16-bit room inspired by Winnie's familiar belongings: warm cream walls and sofa, light wood floor, a yellow-covered crate and blush pink bed, with apricot Winnie and his blue gingham bandanna. The top of Today is a living pixel diorama in which pixel Winnie acts out only what the shared log has recorded, under the real San Francisco sky. Everything below it keeps the periwinkle-and-navy game UI: big pixel-edged buttons that press down, square HUD pills, cards drawn with a 2px ink line, sticky notes pinned with a square magnet. Nothing is rounded.

Density is phone-first and one-handed. Today starts with the room, one status line, two big log tiles, a row of four chips, then permanent Care rows, inside a 560px column. Colour is loud but disciplined: each care type owns exactly one saturated colour and that colour means that type everywhere it appears (tile, chip, timeline square, strip tick, chart bar, sheet button). UI neutrals are cool periwinkle-tinted paper and navy ink; warm cream, wood and fabric colours belong to the room's physical objects.

Personality lives in the room, the motion, and the family's own words. The interface copy is a label maker. Winnie never speaks; he emotes in pixel bubbles. Rejected and retired: the pastel card-grid pet dashboard with a hero photo and serif headline, and warm taglines ("our good boy", "His story", "A life worth remembering").
keyCharacteristics: One pixel diorama at the top of Today, drawn on an integer art-pixel grid, scaled nearest-neighbour.
One colour per care type, identical everywhere.
Square corners only; pixel edges drawn with four 3px ink box-shadow sides.
Pressable things sit on a 7px ledge and press down 3px; flat things (cards, lists) do not.
Pixelify Sans for short labels and numbers, Rubik for running UI text, both self-hosted.
Stepped motion (`steps()`) throughout; no eased tweens.
Light and dark schemes; the care colours and ink do not change between them.

rules.name: The One Colour Per Care Type Rule
rules.body: A care type has exactly one colour token and it appears wherever that type does. Never give a type a second colour, and never borrow a care colour for decoration unrelated to that type (Sun Yellow as the "selected" fill is the one established exception).

rules.name: The Navy Ink Rule
rules.body: UI outlines and text on colour use navy ink (`ink`). Room controls retain that ink; physical furniture, wood joints, fabric edges and the ribbon use their own darker material shades.

rules.name: The Short Words Rule
rules.body: Pixelify Sans sets words and numbers, never sentences. If it wraps to a second line of prose, it should be Rubik.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All UI text is sentence case. No all-caps labels.

rules.name: The Press Is The Depth Rule
rules.body: A ledge means "this moves when touched" (or is a paper object). Cards and lists never get one.

dos: Do colour every appearance of a care type with its one token from `TYPES` in `public/icons.js` (`typeColor(type)`), in tiles, chips, icon squares, strip ticks and charts.
Do draw pressable controls with the pixel edge, the 7px ledge and the 3px press; draw cards and lists flat with a 2px `edge` border.
Do set short labels, headings, times and counts in Pixelify Sans and sentences in Rubik; set inputs at 16px.
Do write copy like a label maker: nouns, verbs, times and names in sentence case ("Pee logged · 4:07 PM", "Finish walk", "None yet", "Nothing planned"). Buttons name exactly what they do.
Do let Winnie respond to a log with an action in the room while the toast offers Undo.
Do derive every room state from a recorded fact: an active sleep, an active walk, a logged meal, pending changes, notes on the fridge, a plan due.
Do use `steps()` timing and whole-pixel moves for any new motion, and give reduced motion a still, settled pose.
Do retain gingham in Winnie's bandanna, the active tab square and the desktop backdrop; render the room's furniture in its observed cream, pink and yellow materials.
Do use navy ink for UI outlines and text on coloured surfaces; use darker material shades where the room's physical objects need edges.
donts: Don't show Winnie sad, hungry, needy or waiting, or infer any state from gaps in the log. No streaks, scores or guilt.
Don't give Winnie words; he only emotes (`z ! ? ~ nom` and a heart).
Don't add a second colour for a care type or reuse a care colour for an unrelated meaning.
Don't round UI corners or use blurred shadows (pixel art draws its own curves on the grid).
Don't use eased or springy CSS curves; use stepped timing.
Don't use taglines, "our / together / moments / story / little", exclamation marks, em dashes or rhetorical questions in UI copy.
Don't set paragraphs in Pixelify Sans or use all-caps labels.
Don't smooth-scale pixel art or draw it off the art grid; scale by integers with `image-rendering: pixelated`.
Don't replace navy UI outlines with brown or black; room material shading is separate from the UI palette.
Don't lead with a hero photo or a pastel card grid; the room is the top of Today.
